2609.21214.title: Ability-Residual Decoupled Modeling for Affective Cognitive Diagnosis
2609.21214.paper_summary: Cognitive diagnosis infers students' concept mastery from response logs. However, students' responses are not determined by mastery alone: non-cognitive factors such as emotion, engagement, and fatigue can also affect performance. Affective cognitive diagnosis therefore extends conventional cognitive diagnosis by incorporating affective states. Existing methods often assume that the cognitive diagnosis backbone has already explained ability, item, and concept effects, so the remaining errors can be attributed mainly to affect. We argue that this assumption can be insufficient in real educational data: item calibration bias, systematic concept bias, personalized student-concept deviations, and latent student-item matching can form stable cognitive residuals. Without an explicit modeling pathway, these residuals may leak into affective representations, producing affect contamination. To address this problem, we propose an ability-residual decoupled framework for affective cognitive diagnosis. The model first captures unmodeled cognitive residuals through student, item, concept, student-concept, and low-rank student-item components, and then uses an affective module to modulate guess/slip effects. A Q-matrix-constrained concept residual attention mechanism adaptively aggregates only item-relevant concept residuals. Experiments on ASSIST2017, ASSIST2012, ASSIST2009, and Junyi with six cognitive diagnosis backbones show response-prediction gains across the reported comparisons and generally improved affect alignment when affect labels are available. Ablation studies, leakage probes, principal component analysis visualization, long-tail analysis, and case studies further indicate that ability residuals absorb stable cognitive bias, reduce cognitive contamination in the affective branch, and enhance the robustness and predictive accuracy of cognitive diagnosis models.
2609.21214.paper_summary_zh: 認知診斷從反應日誌推斷學生的概念掌握情況。然後，學生的反應不僅僅由掌握程度決定：非認知因素如情緒、參與度和疲勞也會影響表現。因此，情感認知診斷通過納入情感狀態來擴展傳統的認知診斷。現有的方法通常假設認知診斷的基礎已經解釋了能力、項目和概念的影響，因此剩餘的誤差主要可以歸因於情感。我們認為這一假設在真實的教育數據中可能不夠充分：項目標定偏差、系統性概念偏差、個性化的學生-概念偏差以及潛在的學生-項目匹配可能形成穩定的認知殘差。若沒有明確的建模途徑，這些殘差可能會滲透到情感表徵中，產生情感污染。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個能力-殘差解耦框架，用於情感認知診斷。該模型首先通過學生、項目、概念、學生-概念和低秩學生-項目組件捕捉未建模的認知殘差，然後使用情感模塊來調節猜測/滑動效應。一個受Q矩陣約束的概念殘差注意機制自適應地聚合僅與項目相關的概念殘差。在ASSIST2017、ASSIST2012、ASSIST2009和Junyi上進行的實驗顯示，在報告的比較中，反應預測的增益，以及在情感標籤可用時，情感對齊的普遍改善。消融研究、泄漏探測、主成分分析可視化、長尾分析和案例研究進一步表明，能力殘差吸收了穩定的認知偏差，減少了情感分支中的認知污染，並增強了認知診斷模型的穩健性和預測準確性。
2609.21214.author: Boyuan Zhao et.al.
